For security/privacy problems, use SECURITY.md instead of a public issue.

- Source revision and platform/client version:
- Expected behavior:
- Observed behavior:
- Minimal synthetic reproduction and focused test command:
- Which evidence boundary was tested (fixture, installed client, signed package):

Do not attach real prompts, config files, account details, browser profiles,
vault/recovery keys or unreviewed diagnostics. Redact any private paths.
